commit_message:
Add SyncRepository

Writes are spaced 800 ms apart: the sync API answers 429 Too Many
Requests to writes from the same device less than 800 ms apart.
noise: Fetch the items from the API
context: Hive boxes must not be opened twice; keep this lazy and shared.
The API sends updatedAt in seconds, not milliseconds.
stale: Returns an empty list when the device is offline.
